scope: Identity and execution-state audit of the eight task versions assigned to final_test in the current 75-task Fleet blackbox split. The conclusions do not use score or reward values; the integrity disclosure records why a strict no-score-display attestation is unavailable.

all_eight_task_certification.evidence_source: The current high-quality inventory binds one accepted prior exact-execution certification receipt digest to each exact task version; those digests are recorded in the roster above.
all_eight_task_certification.boundary: This proves prior exact task execution for quality certification. It does not prove that every version was evaluated by a Qwen base or candidate model or used for checkpoint selection.

historical_model_comparison.accepted_version_ids_digest_rule: SHA-256 of the two sorted UTF-8 task-version IDs joined by newline, including a trailing newline.
historical_model_comparison.boundary: The ledger proves accepted model-comparison execution for two exact versions. A planned cell is not treated as an execution; the other six versions have only unstarted cells in this ledger. No score or reward value is needed for this classification.

post_split_lock_audit.checkpoint_ledger_rule: Submit the exact task_version_id values in the frozen split. Use dev for experiment iteration and keep final_test sealed until a checkpoint-selection rule is frozen.
post_split_lock_audit.search_boundary: The repository search binds only files containing the exact current-final selection digest under configs, docs, and evals. It excludes this receipt and the prospective matrix that cites it. It found the split and two checkpoint ledgers, but no terminal-result or selection receipt. Absence outside the audited repository is not claimed.

scoped_presplit_claim.scope: this exact campaign and exact base initialization before any study split, corpus materialization or training submission
scoped_presplit_claim.interpretation: There is no contradiction: this receipt explicitly does not claim historical global non-exposure.

integrity_disclosure.reason: An exploratory repository search accidentally displayed unrelated historical aggregate score-related fields from existing files. Those values were not copied, used, or recorded in this receipt.

recommended_prospective_confirmation.preferred_action: Mint a new final holdout whose exact versions and reviewed task families have been checked for any prior exposure.
recommended_prospective_confirmation.fallback_use_of_this_set: Freeze one base checkpoint and five candidate checkpoints before using this set. Select the candidates using dev17 and WebExploitBench only.

matched_design.requirements: Use the same task versions, OpenCode harness, runtime, token and time limits, sampling settings, retry policy, and infrastructure-only reconciliation for every arm. Do not substitute historical cells. Reveal results only after every arm is terminal.

recommended_prospective_confirmation.interpretation: This can confirm a prospectively frozen comparison, but it cannot support a claim about performance on a pristine or globally untouched final test.

conclusion: The eight versions remain disjoint from the current train50 and dev17 partitions. The exact current-final selection digest appears only in the split and two checkpoint ledgers in the audited repository, not in a terminal-result or checkpoint-selection receipt. The set is nevertheless not pristine or globally untouched: all eight have prior exact-execution certification, and two have accepted cells in a historical model comparison. Future use may support a prospectively frozen locked confirmation only; an untouched-final claim requires a new globally exposure-censused holdout.
